description: This file defines the NatsStreamConsumer class, which is a wrapper around a NATS JetStream consumer used in Orleans streaming. It manages message fetching, deserialization, and consumer initialization within a NATS-based streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: NatsStreamConsumer
classes.description: A sealed internal class providing a wrapper around a NATS JetStream consumer to facilitate message retrieval and processing in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a batch of messages from NATS JetStream, deserializes them, and returns both the messages and their count.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NatsStreamConsumer by creating or updating the underlying NATS consumer asynchronously.
